description.value: Kolbeh is a family-owned Persian restaurant that has served the North Shore community for over 30 years, making it one of the oldest Persian restaurants in the area. The menu spans traditional soups such as halim and kaleh pacheh, wraps and donairs, braised meat sandwiches, and Persian breakfast platters. Takeout is available, and the kitchen labels vegetarian and gluten-free options clearly throughout the menu.
